scope: Own shipping build-cache only, exact IDs independently reviewed; no global prune.
healthIncident: Four main healthchecks became unhealthy at disk exhaustion; all13 recovered after first owned-cache removal without restart.
underlyingDriver: vfs; full-copy cache snapshots consumed much more disk than logical Docker cache sizes.
harnessLimits: One metadata check compared unordered Docker mount arrays; consecutive read-only inspections proved same image and mount sets. Canonical sorted-set comparison retained all identity checks.
Mobile static initial version-key expectation was corrected to existing latest schema; image/HTTP checks unchanged.
First buildx invocation failed because its client cache attempted read-only HOME; only BUILDX_CONFIG moved to own workspace cache, Docker credentials/config untouched.
